metadata.note: Canonical numeric spacing scale. A step name is its pixel value in canonical integer form (0 or no leading zeroes), so an instruction ('use spacing 8') maps to exactly one token (--space-8) and one utility family (p-8, gap-8). 0 is the identity step (no spacing). This is an intentionally DEFINED primitive scale, not an inventory of current usage: a step may exist with no consumers yet (32/40/64 are reserved primitives). Do not add a step (e.g. 6) without an explicit design decision.
